description: This file defines an abstract helper class 'TabHelper' for managing tabbed navigation in an Android app, with factory methods to create platform-specific implementations and methods for tab creation and state management.

classes.name: TabHelper
classes.description: An abstract class providing tab management functionality with platform-specific behavior.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method that returns a platform-specific TabHelper instance based on OS version.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab with given tag, returning either a Honeycomb or Eclair version.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Abstract method to add a tab to the helper.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Abstract method for saving instance state.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Abstract method for restoring instance state.
